name: the-wong-marketplace
description: A curated marketplace of Claude Code skills.

plugins.name: securities-filings-lookup
plugins.description: Look up official securities filings (SEC EDGAR, HKEX, CNINFO, FCA NSM, TDnet/EDINET, SGX) by ticker or company name and save the originals as PDFs.

plugins.name: can-slim-grader
plugins.description: Grade a single stock ticker against the CAN SLIM growth-investing model and return a C-A-N-S-L-I-M scorecard with a BUY-RANGE / WATCH / AVOID verdict.

plugins.name: can-slim-recommend
plugins.description: Sweep the market sector by sector with live TradingView data and return ranked recommendation lists graded with the CAN SLIM methodology.

plugins.name: ibkr-review-ticker
plugins.description: Illustrated single-stock review dashboard using live IBKR data: fundamentals vs peers, options and volatility positioning, and a probabilistic 6-month outlook.

plugins.name: redemption-seats-search
plugins.description: Find business and first class award seats between two airports on a given date via the seats.aero Partner API. Requires a seats.aero API key.
